objective: USINE run 'b1-slab-all-items' translated from a transport block (adapters/cr-propagation/assets/usine_translate.py)

extension.input_manifest_note: sha256 is of each file as run, with the absolute paths of the run directory and of USINE's inputs folder written into usine.init.par; committed_form_sha256 is of the same file written with the placeholders <TOOL_HOME>/inputs and <RUN_DIR> (the form committed under tests/adapters/fixtures/cr_propagation/usine/inputs/), equal to sha256 for the files that hold no path; entries with read_in_place are USINE's own files (GPL-2.0), hashed where they lie and never copied

tools.name: USINE
tools.version: V3.5 (git tag V3.5, commit fb53006db41d1a640bf1b5af1a4b0f899ca59673; built with Apple clang 21.0.0 against ROOT 6.38.04)

seeds.note: USINE's local-flux calculation is deterministic: no random numbers are drawn

tolerances.note: USINE EPS_ITERCONV 1e-6, EPS_INTEGR 1e-4, EPS_NORMDATA 1e-10 (written into the initialisation file); outputs printed with 6 significant digits

extension.exit_status_note: exit_status is the run's outcome as judged by usine_translate.py (0: every expected output written, no USINE error or crash in the log); USINE V3.5 itself returns 1 on every path (usine_exit_status)
notes: 10Be half-life: USINE chart 1.387 Myr, NUBASE2020 1.387 My (core.constants.physical)
diffusion.form 'beta^eta (R/R0)^delta with smooth breaks': not parsed; K = beta^eta K0 (Rig/R0)^delta times the break factors is fixed by the canonical fields
low break form (1 + (R_break/Rig)^((delta - delta_below)/s))^s of the plugin's 'usine' convention (transport_conventions.py; not re-read from Weinrich et al. 2020a)
reacceleration.relation 'Seo-Ptuskin 1994': momentum diffusion Kpp of USINE's shipped files (Seo-Ptuskin form)
electron-capture decay off: fully stripped nuclei (7Be) are stable (r3 P6)

cross_sections.ghost_threshold 'off: ghost nuclei and tertiary chains off on both sides': not parsed; ghost nuclei are not loaded (IsLoadGhosts false; the cumulative cross sections of USINE's chart crcharts_Zmax30_ghost97.dat) and tertiary chains are off
sources.injection species_group ['all primaries']: one slope for every primary of the network
sources.spatial 'not fixed by harmonized-v1; each code records its choice': not parsed; the 1D model's sources fill the thin disc
gas 'uniform, n_H = 1 cm^-3': HI = 1 cm^-3, HII = H2 = 0 in the thin disc of half-thickness h; USINE's Coulomb loss acts on HII and is therefore zero
gas He_to_H_number 0.1: not used; the ILLUSTRATIVE cross sections are on hydrogen only and no helium cross section is invented (He density 0, target H)

cross_sections.production_set 'theory:cr-secondary-ratio models/xs-illustrative-decay.json (ILLUSTRATIVE, isotopic)' and inelastic_set 'theory:cr-secondary-ratio models/xs-illustrative-decay.json (ILLUSTRATIVE, isotopic)': the ILLUSTRATIVE set xs-illustrative-decay
production channels not in the set are zero (USINE needs every pair of the network)

reacceleration V_A_kms 5 in the whole halo: thin-disc V_A = 20.4124 km/s (factor 4.08248 = sqrt(L/(3h)), transport_conventions.py reacceleration, same c and w); approximate, relative_error_bound 0.3121 = (1 + lam)/5 on the second-order term in V_A^2 of the disc flux, with lam = h Gamma L / D = 0.5607, its largest value over the run's species and E_k/n grid (16O at 1.995 GeV/n); convection is on, outside the conversion's assumptions
source spectrum dQ/dE_k/n = q Rig^-2.3 (USINE POWERLAW, eta_s = 0)

parent abundances: each parent source scaled until its unmodulated local flux at E_k/n = 10 GeV/n is in the ratio C 1, O 0.9 (theory:cr-secondary-ratio parent list); USINE NormList with generated points, not data
sources.abundances 'fixed by the parent list of theory:cr-secondary-ratio': not parsed; the parent ratios above are used
tertiary chains, ghost nuclei and exotic primaries off
family 'BIG-like test of the translator (ILLUSTRATIVE cross sections)': a label of the model family, not read by the translator
free []: one run fixes every parameter; a fit varies the free ones
not given in the transport block, the translator's value used: geometry.local_bubble_radius_kpc = 0.0 kpc (no local bubble)
